title: 14、苟富贵，勿相忘（修）
content_zh:
南庚辰看着庆尘，怔然了半晌：“大哥，我是想找派出所里的警察叔叔帮忙，像叔叔他被抓紧去这种帮不上什么忙啊。”
“那就没办法了，”庆尘摇摇头，他进一步问道：“你遇到很诡异的事情了吗？到底是什么事？”
“没事没事，”南庚辰对此闭口不言。
庆尘不再说话。
这种事情对方不愿意说，那自己也就只能当做不知情。
不过他心中有了隐隐的猜测，南庚辰所谓的诡异……会不会是手臂上也出现了倒计时？
但倒计时别人是看不见的，所以庆尘也只能靠猜测。
自己的第一次穿越倒计时是昨天晚上6点出现的，他当时就逃课走了，没有上晚自习，晚上12点就进行了第一次穿越。
如果南庚辰手臂上真的也出现了倒计时，那会是什么时候出现的呢？
庆尘心想，这南庚辰瘦瘦小小的，一看就弱不禁风的样子，要是真的穿越去那个世界也不知道能不能生存下来啊。
他们俩关系还不错，也不是因为俩人性格多么合得来，而是俩人的父亲都打牌、赌博，搞得彼此家庭条件都不怎么样。
偶然间聊起这个事情后，两个少年反而因此拉近了关系。
关注公众号：书友大本营关注即送现金、点币！
就在此时，班级里忽然有正在玩手机的同学惊呼一声：“卧槽！”
还没到上课时间，整个高二3班只有十来个同学在教室里，大家把目光转过去：“咋了？”
“你们快看热搜，雅各布开了一个新闻发布会，说他穿越到了一个机械文明世界，热搜上有他发布会的完整视频，”那位惊叫出声的同学说道。
雅各布，美国国籍，世界最出名的篮球明星之一，粉丝很多。
班里同学听了这话立刻
只有庆尘愣在当场，因为他知道那所谓的穿越与机械文明是怎么回事！
可是，他之前还真没想到，原来国外也有人在经历穿越与倒计时这样的事情。

南庚辰已经
视频里雅各布坐在桌子后面，面对着他临时请去的所有媒体，现场闪光灯密集的闪烁着，让人有些眼花缭乱。
可所有观看视频的人，第一眼就看到雅各布的左臂，因为那支左臂已经完全换成了机械手臂。
视频里，雅各布起身带大家去篮球场，然后隔着整个球场，用左手轻松将篮球投入篮筐，一连十个都是如此。
“这是特效吗？”南庚辰喃喃道：“是不是拍的广告片，做的特效啊？”
庆尘没有说话。
视频是有人从国外搬运回来的，还为视频配上了中文字幕。
视频里雅各布对媒体说道：“我昨天晚上意外发现自己手臂上出现倒计时，当倒计时结束的时候我竟然穿梭到了一个奇怪的机械文明世界，那里也是地球，有太阳有月亮，但似乎是平行宇宙，文明进程与我们所在的世界截然不同。”
雅各布举起自己的左臂：“我穿越过去便拥有了这条手臂，就像是我替代了那边的某个人一样，成为了新的自己。我也不清楚它是什么原理，但它的力气远超我想象，而且非常灵活、精准。”
“而我召开新闻发布会的原因并不是要向各位炫耀，那个世界也并非想象的那么美好，反而异常危险。我在这里召开新闻发布会是为了避免我被秘密带走进行研究，我在这里声明，本人拒绝成为研究对象，如果有一天我失踪，请各位……”
庆尘看到这里恍然，雅各布是个公众人物，所以自己身上有了机械肢体根本瞒不住。
对方又很清楚那个世界的科技远超当代，所以生怕自己被带走研究成为小白鼠，就选择了更加激进的方法。
这未必是个好办法，也可能对方比较慌张，所以仓促做了这么一个决定。
庆尘看向南庚辰，此时瘦瘦小小的同桌呆若木鸡。
而庆尘在想，自己没能将剔骨刀带过去，也没能将牙刷带回来，看来想要从那边带东西的唯一方法，就是改造自己，或者藏在身体里？
也不知道雅各布穿越过去是出现在哪里，大洋彼岸吗？
此时，班级里所有学生都陷入震惊与将信将疑的状态里，大家甚至很难判断这个热搜到底是真的，还是合成特效。
然而还没等大家回过神来呢，热搜排名忽然又有几个诡异事件冲上了榜单。
“某互联网高管被发现死于家中，身上忽然出现精密的机械构造，与雅各布极其相似。”
“某大学生声称自己也穿越到了另一个世界，那里不止有机械文明，还有超越常人的超凡者。”

“某高中生宣称自己不仅穿越到了另一个世界，还获得了觉醒异能。”
庆尘皱起眉头看着，这一系列新闻要比他想象中来的更快，并不是所有人都能像他一样谨慎。
越来越多的新闻都在向世人宣告：这不是特效，也不是广告文案，而是真实存在的。
真的有人穿越到了那个未知而又充满幻想的世界。
而且，穿越者并不在少数。
他身边的南庚辰喃喃道：“超凡者，机械文明……那穿越过去是不是有机会成为超凡者？”
有同学问道：“我看着穿越概率不小啊，咱们学校里会不会也有同学穿越？”
“也许就有人带着机械肢体来上学了……”
“我也想穿越……”
班级里的同学越来越多，每当有人走近教室的时候，大家都会将目光投去，看看对方有没有机械肢体。
要知道他们才十七八岁的年纪，正是好奇心与探索欲、虚荣心最浓烈的时候，成年人或许会考虑危险与机遇是否对等，但少年人更多的则是期待。
你看哈利波特的时候会期待自己也能穿过国王车站，看小说的时候也希望自己可以得到仙人接引。
但现实世界是，一般情况下迎接你的都不是仙人，而是仙人跳。
所以当大家发现穿越过去后可以变得与众不同，那他们会过滤掉一些危险信息，然后期待自己也是穿越者之一。
世界的主角，听起来就很有诱惑力。
庆尘也很难例外。
只是有一点不同，庆尘真的穿越过，而且也真的见过传说中那些超凡脱俗的人，林小笑、李叔同。
叶晚应该也是。
慢慢的，庆尘发现南庚辰的慌张神色褪去，反而渐渐精神抖擞了起来。
庆尘漫不经心的问道：“你刚才说的诡异的事情就是这个吗？”

南庚辰压低了声音：“现在还不能告诉你，但你放心，如果我能得到什么机遇，一定不会忘了兄弟你的。”
庆尘点头：“嗯嗯，苟富贵勿相忘。”
content_en:
Nan Gengchen looked at Qingchen and was stunned for a long time: "Brother, I want to ask the police uncle at the police station for help. I can't help him as he was caught quickly."
"Then there's nothing we can do," Qingchen shook his head and asked further, "Did you encounter something weird? What on earth was it?"
"It's okay, it's okay," Nan Gengchen said nothing.
Qingchen stopped talking.
If the other party is unwilling to talk about this kind of thing, then I can only treat it as unaware.
However, he had a vague guess in his mind. Nan Gengchen's so-called weirdness...could it be that a countdown also appeared on his arm?
But the countdown cannot be seen by others, so Qingchen can only rely on guessing.
The countdown to his first time travel occurred at 6 o'clock last night. He skipped class at that time and did not attend evening self-study. He performed his first time travel at 12 o'clock in the evening.
If a countdown really appeared on Nan Gengchen's arm, when would it appear?
Qingchen thought to himself, this Nan Gengchen was so thin and small that he looked extremely frail at first glance. If he really traveled to that world, he didn't know whether he would survive.
The two of them have a good relationship, not because their personalities are so compatible, but because both of their fathers play cards and gamble, which makes their family conditions poor.
After accidentally talking about this matter, the two teenagers became closer to each other.
Follow the public account: Book Friends Base Camp and you will get cash and coins for free!
At this moment, a classmate in the class who was playing with his mobile phone suddenly exclaimed: "Fuck!"
It was not yet class time, and there were only about a dozen students in Class 3 of the second grade of high school in the classroom. Everyone turned their eyes and asked, "What's wrong?"
"Look at the hot search. Jacob held a press conference, saying that he traveled to a mechanical civilization world. There is a complete video of his press conference on the hot search," said the classmate who screamed.
Jacob, an American national, is one of the most famous basketball stars in the world and has many fans.
After hearing this, the classmates immediately
Only Qingchen was stunned on the spot, because he knew what the so-called time travel and mechanical civilization was about!
However, he never thought before that there were people abroad who were experiencing time travel and countdown.
Nan Gengchen has
In the video, Jacob is sitting behind a desk, facing all the media he has temporarily invited. The flash lights flashing intensively make people dazzled.
But everyone who watched the video saw Jacob's left arm at first glance, because that left arm has been completely replaced by a robotic arm.
In the video, Jacob got up and took everyone to the basketball court, and then easily threw the basketball into the basket with his left hand across the entire court, ten times in a row.
"Is this a special effect?" Nan Gengchen murmured, "Is it a special effect for a commercial?"
Qingchen said nothing.
The video was brought back from abroad by someone, and Chinese subtitles were added to the video.
In the video, Jacob told the media: "I accidentally discovered a countdown on my arm last night. When the countdown ended, I actually traveled to a strange mechanical civilization world. It is also the earth, with the sun and the moon, but it seems to be a parallel universe, and the civilization process is completely different from the world we live in."
Jacob raised his left arm: "I have this arm since I traveled through the past. It's like I replaced someone over there and became a new me. I don't know how it works, but its strength is far beyond my imagination, and it is very flexible and precise."
"And the reason why I held the press conference was not to show off to you. That world is not as beautiful as imagined, but is extremely dangerous. I held the press conference here to prevent me from being secretly taken away for research. I declare here that I refuse to be a research subject. If one day I disappear, please..."
QingchenSeeing this, it suddenly dawned on me that Jacob was a public figure, so he couldn't hide the fact that he had mechanical limbs.
The other party also knew very well that the technology in that world was far ahead of contemporary times, so he was afraid that he would be taken away and studied as a guinea pig, so he chose a more radical method.
This may not be a good idea, or the other party may be in a panic, so they made such a hasty decision.
Qingchen looked at Nan Gengchen. At this moment, his thin and thin deskmate was dumbfounded.
And Qingchen was thinking that he failed to bring the boning knife over, and he failed to bring the toothbrush back. It seems that the only way to bring things from there is to transform himself, or hide it in the body?
Don’t you know where Jacob appeared when he traveled to the past? On the other side of the ocean?
At this time, all the students in the class were in a state of shock and disbelief. It was even difficult for everyone to judge whether this hot search was real or a synthetic special effect.
However, before everyone could recover, several strange events suddenly appeared on the hot search rankings.
"An Internet executive was found dead at home. A sophisticated mechanical structure suddenly appeared on his body, which was very similar to Jacob."
"A certain college student claimed that he also traveled to another world, where there are not only mechanical civilizations, but also extraordinary beings who are beyond ordinary people."
"A certain high school student claimed that he not only traveled to another world, but also gained awakening powers."
Qingchen frowned and watched. This series of news came faster than he thought. Not everyone can be as cautious as him.
More and more news are announcing to the world: This is not a special effect or advertising copy, but a real thing.
Someone really traveled to that unknown and fantasy world.
Moreover, there are not a few time travellers.
Nan Gengchen beside him murmured: "Transcendents, mechanical civilization... Then is there a chance to become a transcendent by traveling to the past?"
Some students asked: "I think the probability of time travel is not small. Will there be students in our school who can time travel?"
"Maybe someone comes to school with a mechanical limb..."
"I also want to travel through time..."
There are more and more students in the class. Whenever someone approaches the classroom, everyone will look at them to see if they have mechanical limbs.
You must know that they are only seventeen or eighteen years old, which is when curiosity, desire for exploration, and vanity are strongest. Adults may consider whether danger and opportunity are equal, but young people are more looking forward to it.
When you read Harry Potter, you hope that you can walk through King's Station, and when you read the novel, you also hope that you can be greeted by immortals.
But in the real world, what usually greets you is not an immortal, but an immortal jumping.
So when people discover that they can become different after traveling through the past, they will filter out some dangerous information, and then hope that they will also be one of the time travellers.
The protagonist of the world sounds very tempting.
Qingchen is hardly an exception.
There's just one difference. Qingchen has really traveled through time and met those legendary extraordinary people, Lin Xiaoxiao and Li Shutong.
Ye Wan should be too.
Slowly, Qingchen noticed that Nan Gengchen's panicked expression faded away, and he gradually became more energetic.
Qingchen asked casually: "Is this the weird thing you just said?"
Nan Gengchen lowered his voice: "I can't tell you now, but don't worry, if I get any opportunity, I will definitely not forget you, brother."
Qingchen nodded: "Yeah, let's not forget each other even if we are rich or noble."
